high_level_description: This image depicts an outdoor patio area with a modern design. The structure is primarily composed of a stone wall that features a mix of gray and yellow stones, giving it a rustic yet contemporary look. The roof is flat and appears to be made of metal, providing a sleek contrast to the natural stone elements. On the left side of the patio, there is a built-in seating area with red cushioned chairs and a small table, suggesting a cozy spot for relaxation or dining.
